items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Macy Gray has been incredible; she’s come out for us.

ctx.x: But there are other places where they might...

Half of them love rock-and-roll. They all love blues. Everyone loves the blues. It depends on what jazz you’re talking about. If we’re talking about Billie Holiday and Chet Baker and Abbey Lincoln, then everyone, hands-down, would melt over that. If you’re talking about avant-garde, that could be an acquired taste to someone. But these guys get into everything. We try to make sure all our events give you a taste of everything, and it becomes a smorgasbord of music. We’ll put R&B. We’ll put Soul. Macy Gray has…
